worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.summary: Launch a hard-packed mud ball straight at the aimed direction or spot; it bursts on impact, the main target takes the hit while smaller clods splash onto those nearby, and a solid hit sometimes blinds the target.
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.use.0: A straight heavy hit at mid-to-long range
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.use.1: Catch enemies standing near the target with the burst
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.use.2: Sometimes blind the target and cut its accuracy
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.description.0: Mud Bomb deals about %1$s special damage and has a %2$s chance to obscure the target’s eyes, lowering accuracy by %3$s stages for 3.5 seconds. Cleansing the mud restores accuracy early, and repeated hits do not stack. No blindness is applied when the hit deals no damage.
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.description.1: The burst splashes outward from the real contact surface; every other reachable enemy within a radius of %2$s blocks takes about %1$s special damage (lighter than the main hit), while enemies behind a wall take none.
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.description.2: The ball flies nearly straight at %1$s up to %2$s blocks and bursts on terrain or an enemy, spraying a short ring of mud only on the real contact surface; the floor is never changed into mud. Fragmentation shell: %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudbomb.preference.she: On: blast radius ×1.35, ball speed ×1.1 and a wider splash, but single-target power ×0.82, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: a heavier solid ball with a shorter wind-up and the base blast radius.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values fire from further away.
On: it prefers a target with other enemies nearby so the burst catches more. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
